product_metadata.title: IRIS USA 2-Drawer Modular Wood Stacking Storage Box, for Office Closet and Nightstand, Easy Assembly, Stacking Storage Boxes, Black
features: Storage shelves with easy slide drawers are a stylish way to store and organize papers, accessories, notebooks, and more.
Stack box drawers with drawer stops fit letter sized paper, and stack up to three storage boxes vertically with included stability pins.
Easy to assemble stacking box with included parts (screwdriver required). compliant with CARB regulation 93120 – Phase 2.
Mix and match from multiple Styles and colors to Complement any Décor for unlimited customizable cubby storage options.
Assembled Dimensions: 11.42"L x 15.75"W x 12.00"H; Inner Dimensions (Per Drawer): 9.25"L x 13.25"W x 3.5"H
description: Efficiently style your storage and save space with our stackable cube drawer. Two storage drawers neatly stow your papers, files, office supplies and more to help you stay organized and keep clutter contained, while stoppers prevent drawers from falling out. Stack up to three cube shelves vertically to squeeze extra storage out of small spaces. Drawer cubes are ideal for use as a mail organizer, file organizer, desk organizer, or stack two cubbies to create a clever side table. With multiple styles and different colors, you can mix and match the stackable shelves to create a customizable cube organizer that suits all your unique storage needs. Some assembly required. Inner Dimensions (per drawer): 9. 25"L x 13. 25"W x 3. 5"H. Weight capacity: 6. 6 pounds per drawer, 22 pounds top board.
